components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lime action for the main next step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--ink-deep); background: var(--lime); border: 1px solid var(--lime); border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; font-weight: 650; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #e3f88a; border-color: #e3f88a; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6f980c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #cbe254; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered alternative for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 13px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-tint); border-color: #aabbb5; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6f980c; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { background: #e7efeb; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Comfortable field for finding a customer or vehicle.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" aria-label="Buscar clientes" placeholder="Buscar por nombre, matrícula o teléfono">
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid #bccbc6; border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ink); outline: 3px solid #6f980c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Persistent location cue for the selected workshop area.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #e3eeea; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; text-align: left; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 570; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #fff; background: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink-deep); background: var(--lime); font-weight: 720; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6f980c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pending Status Chip
components.description: An amber state for pending work that needs follow-up.
components.css: .ds-status-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 25px; padding: 4px 9px; color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-bg); border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Content Panel
components.description: Flat white work surface for related operational records.
components.html:
Trabajo de hoy

Seguimiento de las citas del taller.
components.css: .ds-content-panel { padding: 22px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-content-panel h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-content-panel p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Service Stage Track
components.description: Connected markers show completed, current, and upcoming workshop stages.
components.css: .ds-stage-track { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-stage-track li { position: relative; padding-top: 21px; color: #7a8a86; font: inherit; font-size: 10px; } .ds-stage-track li::before { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 9px; height: 9px; content: ''; background: var(--surface); border: 2px solid #bdcbc6; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-stage-track li::after { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 11px; right: 0; height: 2px; content: ''; background: #d7e1de; } .ds-stage-track li:last-child::after { display: none; } .ds-stage-track li.is-done::before { background: #a9cf50; border-color: #668f22; } .ds-stage-track li.is-done::after { background: #82a83e; } .ds-stage-track li.is-current::before { background: var(--lime); border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #edf5d6; } .ds-stage-track li.is-current { color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview:
This implementation-derived direction is an explicit working assumption, not a confirmed brand choice. TallerCoches should make the workshop's daily flow legible at a glance: keep the main work areas one familiar navigation action away, show the next operational step, and reserve strong color for meaningful state. The visual world pairs a deep petrol rail with a cool service-bay canvas and crisp white work surfaces.

The interface is practical and calm rather than promotional. Compact labels and aligned information support quick scanning, while the lime accent marks the active destination, current progress, and primary action. Warning and critical colors stay reserved for exceptions. Appointment, estimate, inventory, staff, and schedule examples must remain visibly synthetic until those modules are connected to real persistence.
keyCharacteristics: Operational clarity over decorative dashboard metrics.
Petrol navigation, cool neutral workspace, and restrained lime signals.
A connected service-stage track that makes work status visible.
Synthetic data is explicitly labeled and never presented as persisted.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime marks an active action, navigation state, or work-progress state; do not use it as decoration.

rules.name: The Exception-Only Status Rule
rules.body: Amber and red communicate actionable exceptions, not general emphasis.

rules.name: The Scan-First Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use concise headings and compact supporting labels; do not promote secondary metadata above the record or task it describes.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to ordinary cards or navigation items; reserve depth for a selected control or live progress marker.

dos: Do keep daily work, its current stage, and the next action easy to scan.
Do use the petrol rail and cool neutral workspace to maintain a stable frame between modules.
Do label synthetic records and state clearly that demo panels are not persisted.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and make mobile navigation explicit.
donts: Don't use lime as background decoration or across large content areas.
Don't use amber or red for non-status emphasis.
Don't imply synthetic customers, appointments, estimates, or stock are real or saved.
Don't add decorative shadows to ordinary panels.
